credit_line: Gift of Sam Scott and Yares Art Projects
description: Vertical abstract composition of subtle translucent washes of brown, pink, whites, green, blue, yellow and purple. Pencil and charcoal drawing and marks,  blue, red, and  orange  crayon squiggles and circular lines, linear bands of  black and a wash of blue around top and sides of image with a star-like shape in pencil in the top center.  Thin black adhesive material on all edges of paper.
materials: Watercolor, crayon, charcoal and graphite on paper
title: Journey to Center
